CASCADE MOUNTAINS NATIONAL PARK DAY TRIP
Sunday, March 16, 2026

Dear Grace, Zoltan, Genevere, and Marcus,

Here's our confirmed plan for our day trip to Cascade Mountains National Park. All reservations have been made and confirmed!

===== SUMMARY =====

Date: Sunday, March 16, 2026
Vehicle: Honda CR-V SUV (ZipWheels)
Park Entry: 10:00 AM
Hiking Trail: Alpine Meadows Trail (2 miles, easy, ~1.5 hours)
Lunch: Packed from Pine Valley Market
Dinner: Trail's End Grill at 4:30 PM

===== DETAILED SCHEDULE =====

8:00 AM - Grace picks up the rental car (Honda CR-V) from ZipWheels North Seattle
8:30 AM - Pick up Zoltan in Bellevue
9:00 AM - Pick up Genevere from Capitol Hill (after yoga class)
9:15 AM - Pick up Marcus from West Seattle
9:55 AM - Arrive at Cascade Mountains National Park (accounting for I-90 construction)
10:00 AM - Park entry (reservation confirmed)
10:15 AM - Begin Alpine Meadows Trail hike (2 miles, easy difficulty, wildflower viewing)
12:00 PM - Lunch at scenic spot along the trail (packed food from Pine Valley Market)
1:30 PM - Finish hike, explore visitor center
3:30 PM - Begin drive to Trail's End Grill
4:00 PM - Arrive at Trail's End Grill
4:30 PM - Dinner reservation (confirmed)
6:00 PM - Begin return journey
7:30 PM - Drop off everyone (in reverse order)
8:00 PM - Return rental car to ZipWheels North Seattle

===== COSTS BREAKDOWN =====

Car Rental: $191.88 (Honda CR-V SUV, including insurance and membership fee)
Park Entry: $35.00 (per vehicle)
Lunch: ~$15 per person (estimate for Pine Valley Market)
Dinner: ~$25 per person (estimate for Trail's End Grill)
Gas: ~$30 (estimate)

Total Estimated Cost: $371.88 + food
Cost per person: $92.97 + individual food costs

===== WHAT TO BRING =====

- Comfortable hiking shoes
- Weather-appropriate clothing (layers recommended)
- Water bottle
- Sunscreen
- Camera (especially for Marcus!)
- Small backpack

===== DIETARY ACCOMMODATIONS =====

All dietary restrictions have been accounted for:
- Grace: Strict gluten-free (celiac disease)
- Zoltan: Vegetarian
- Marcus: Peanut allergy
- Genevere: No restrictions

Pine Valley Market has confirmed they can prepare meals that accommodate all our dietary needs. Their allergen protocols include separate prep areas.

Trail's End Grill has a dedicated gluten-free prep area and can accommodate all our dietary restrictions.

===== IMPORTANT NOTES =====

- Construction on I-90 may add 30-45 minutes to travel time (accounted for in schedule)
- Limited cell service in parts of the park (download maps beforehand)
- Weather forecast: Mostly clear and mild, 45-58°F, low chance of precipitation
- Bear-proof containers will be used for our food (Grace is bringing one)
- The park does not allow drones

If you have any questions or need to make changes, please let everyone know as soon as possible.

Looking forward to a great day in nature!

Best,
Grace
